sentences.en: A valuable object decreases in value if it is damaged.
sentences.zh: 一个受损的价值物品会减少其价值。

sentences.en: Sudden decrease in appetite is sometimes a sign of illness.
sentences.zh: 突然食欲下降有时是生病的一个迹象。

sentences.en: The mean value of the frequency decreases with increasing amplitude.
sentences.zh: 频率的平均值随着振幅增大而减小。
